_note: Phase 5. The numeric fidelity target for Chamgadad at the reference framing. Mirrored in src/character/chamgadad/fidelity.ts; tests/character.test.ts fails if the two disagree. [A] = my proposal, not yet confirmed by the owner.

framing.coords: normalised 0..1, x right, y down, the drawing's own frame
framing.camera: orthographic, image plane = the drawing; the 3D render must be framed so that the traced contour lands on the same normalised coordinates

compare_against: filled polygon of character/traced/chamgadad_ref_01_head_front.silhouette.json (outer edge of the ink line)

neck_and_chest.source: [A] mine: looser, the neck and chest edge is the part the drawing cuts off

head_volume_method.summary: Distance-to-edge height field from the traced head contour, smoothed, with a fitted back so side and three-quarter views stay plush. Ears are separate meshes attached at traced bases. The traced contour is the union of head, ears and neck, so Phase 6 must first split it into head, left ear, right ear and neck outlines from the ink strokes (the ear bases are hidden behind the head). [A]: the back and sides are inferred.

ink: outline weight is checked by eye in Phase 11, not by IoU
